notes: Reads supported local raw .jsonl and standard Zstandard .jsonl.zst session rollouts under ~/.codex/sessions and ~/.codex/archived_sessions.
Compressed and raw representations use the embedded Codex session UUID for one logical source identity; a simultaneous raw representation wins deterministically.
Reads ~/.codex/history.jsonl when present.

history_locations: Winner: `$CODEX_HOME` or `~/.codex`, deriving `sessions`, `archived_sessions`, and `history.jsonl`.
limitations: Exact supported .jsonl and .jsonl.zst rollouts are manual-importable. Compressed leaves have a 256 MiB combined snapshot/decode-spool bound, a 256x plus 16 MiB expansion bound, a 128 MiB window bound, and share a 1 GiB route scratch budget; SQLite, past roots, and the default beside an override are excluded.

notes: Reads exact DeepSeek Harness local session format version 0 from nested session.jsonl.zstd leaves or configured raw session.jsonl leaves.
An exact compressed or raw leaf remains importable as deepseek_harness_session_jsonl.

history_locations: Winner: nonempty absolute `$DSH_HOME/sessions` or `~/.dsh/sessions`; empty and whitespace-only values are unset, and relative overrides are manual-only.
limitations: Local format version 0 only; other versions, unknown required events, and other layouts fail closed. Child sessions remain independent imports because the durable header does not preserve a transitive root identity. Hosted/cloud history is out of scope, and exact MCP server/tool attribution is not qualified.

notes: Reads authoritative updates.jsonl files under the selected Grok Build sessions root.
An exact updates.jsonl path remains importable as grok_build_session_updates_jsonl.

history_locations: Winner: absolute `$GROK_HOME/sessions` or `~/.grok/sessions`; the override replaces the default.

history_locations: Winner by Pi precedence: session-dir env, agent-dir env plus `sessions`, global settings, trusted exact-CWD project settings, or `~/.pi/agent/sessions`.
limitations: One-shot/API, untrusted or past project, moved, and OMP roots require exact `--path`. One root wins; no ancestor scan or default union.

notes: Reads Claude Code project JSONL transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, including nested subagent transcripts when present.

Where that fast path is unavailable, incremental refresh defers without copying the provider database. Structural edits, deletions, and deferred increments reconcile in roughly 60–80 minutes with a healthy daemon, or on `ctx import --provider hermes` or `ctx import --all`.
Inactive profiles, API databases, mounts, and unregistered installs require exact `--path`.

The system service directory is examined only when the effective UID is 0.

limitations: Missing service metadata returns after fixed exact lookups. Malformed, oversized, unsafe, mismatched, missing-checkout, or symlinked registration data is rejected fail-closed; no checkout/ancestor scan and no nohup/WSL wrapper discovery because that wrapper is checkout-local.

Discovery covers absolute roo-cline.customStoragePath values from bounded VS Code settings/profile selection, finite official VS Code globalStorage roots, the CLI mock root, and explicit paths.

notes: Reads legacy marker-less schema-v1/v2 session.json snapshots accepted by current fx v0.0.6, plus current schema-v3 transactional event logs, from a sessions tree rooted at ~/.fx/sessions or an exact directory with that layout.

For schema v3, authority.json establishes event-log authority, events.jsonl is canonical history, a matching commit.<generation>.json watermark establishes the committed boundary, and session.json is only a projection.
Replays only the committed schema-v3 event-log boundary, including state replacements produced by compaction.

A supported marker-less snapshot and the schema-v3 session created by its upstream migration retain one logical fx session, so migration alone does not duplicate history or rotate stable ctx identities.

history_locations: Default: `~/.fx/sessions`; configured and exact imports accept a directory with the same sessions-tree layout.
limitations: Support is limited to legacy marker-less schema-v1/v2 snapshots accepted by current fx v0.0.6 and current schema-v3 transactional event logs. Marker-less schema-v3 snapshots, future schemas, hosted history, and exact MCP server/tool attribution are not supported.

`authority.json` and a matching `commit.<generation>.json` watermark with no pending commit are required for schema-v3 admission; a schema-v3 `session.json` is not history authority and uncommitted event-log tails are excluded. Legacy snapshots larger than 16 MiB are rejected.
Current fidelity claims cover searchable user and assistant turn content only; tool, command, file-touch, per-turn model, and per-turn token fidelity are not claimed.
